Full-body front-view color character illustration based on the attached reference photos of the real retired Korean MMA champion Lee Yun-jun, stylized as a grounded anime character while keeping his real face, hair and build recognizable. He stands relaxed but perfectly balanced with his weight even on both feet, arms hanging loosely at his sides, hands half open, chin slightly down, a calm, composed, slightly serious face with steady eyes and a closed mouth. He is a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired professional mixed-martial-arts bantamweight champion who now runs a small basement gym: 175 cm, about 7.4 heads tall with realistic proportions, a lean, hard, athletic bantamweight build with a narrow waist, defined but not bulky shoulders and arms, ropy forearms. Light warm skin. An oval face with a clean strong jawline, a straight nose, straight medium-thick black eyebrows, calm narrow eyes with single eyelids, small ears. Black hair parted at the side and swept back and up with a soft fringe falling to one side, cut short at the sides, neatly kept. Outfit: a plain dark grey short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#4A4A48), black loose training pants (#2A2A2C) with a thin white side stripe, dark rubber slippers (#3A3A3A) on bare feet, a small white towel hanging around his neck (#F0EBE2), a black digital sports watch on his left wrist. Plain unbranded clothing. Colors: light warm skin with mauve shadows, black hair, the dark grey t-shirt as the main tone and the white towel as the only bright accent; no orange anywhere. Plain warm off-white paper background (#F4EFE6) with a soft grounding shadow under the feet, whole body visible from hair to soles. Muted cinematic anime cel shading, like a still from a grounded theatrical anime film: flat colors with one crisp shadow tone (a second darker tone only under the chin and beneath the brow), skin shadows in soft mauve-brown, shadows on white cloth in cool blue-grey, soft pink flush on cheeks, nose tip, ears and knuckles. Bold, slightly rough warm near-black outlines (#1A1417), thick on the silhouette and thin inside. Low-to-medium saturation, no gradients on the character, no glossy highlights, no rim-light glow, no eye sparkle, very subtle paper grain.
